nodes.norm_label: container-local testing: phpunit + behat inside moodle-docker
nodes.rationale: Tests must prove real Moodle behaviour (DB, forms, completion, gradebook) and run in WSL2 without host PHP setup. CI-only was rejected: agents need local proof to self-correct. Third-party runners lack Moodle fixtures/generators.

nodes.label: Module grade callbacks: reflectjournal_grade_item_update / reflectjournal_update_grades pair
nodes.norm_label: module grade callbacks: reflectjournal_grade_item_update / reflectjournal_update_grades pair
nodes.rationale: Core calls them together, in that order, from grade_update_mod_grades() and reports a developer warning if only one exists; update_grades only ensures the grade item exists and pushes nothing because the plugin holds no grades.

nodes.label: Calendar integration: provide_event_action + event_timestart_updated callbacks + reflectjournal_refresh_events()
nodes.norm_label: calendar integration: provide_event_action + event_timestart_updated callbacks + reflectjournal_refresh_events()
nodes.rationale: Without the action callback the event is not shown on the dashboard; without the timestart callback it cannot be dragged; core also calls refresh_events() after course reset and after restore.

nodes.norm_label: capability mod/reflectjournal:givefeedback (read any entry, open grade.php, save feedback)

nodes.norm_label: capability mod/reflectjournal:grade (grade field and its save action only)
nodes.rationale: Opens no page of its own: grade.php requires givefeedback; the grade save additionally requires :grade plus sesskey.

nodes.label: core\clock via core\di - never time() in plugin code
nodes.norm_label: core\clock via core\di - never time() in plugin code
nodes.rationale: Tests freeze it with mock_clock_with_frozen(); the deadline check reads the clock so saves one second before and exactly on the deadline are tested exactly.

nodes.label: Custom completion: completionsubmit rule via classes/completion/custom_completion.php
nodes.norm_label: custom completion: completionsubmit rule via classes/completion/custom_completion.php
nodes.rationale: State is entry-row-exists, refreshed with completion_info::update_state(); no view rule because FEATURE_COMPLETION_TRACKS_VIEWS is not declared; the rule is published via get_coursemodule_info customdata.

nodes.label: Course reset: reset_course_form_definition/defaults + reflectjournal_reset_userdata()
nodes.rationale: Must return an array or core reports reset not implemented; deletes entries and their files itself; clears its grade item via grade_item_update($instance,'reset'); shifts deadline with shift_course_mod_dates(); core refreshes calendar events right after.

nodes.label: Data model: reflectjournal + reflectjournal_entries tables (db/install.xml + upgrade.php)
nodes.norm_label: data model: reflectjournal + reflectjournal_entries tables (db/install.xml + upgrade.php)
nodes.rationale: Two places for every schema change: install.xml and upgrade.php behind a savepoint with version.php bumped, so fresh install and upgrade end at the same schema. No draft state: an entry row exists means submitted; timecreated is the submission time.

nodes.label: mod_reflectjournal\dates extends core\activity_dates - deadline on the course page
nodes.norm_label: mod_reflectjournal\dates extends core\activity_dates - deadline on the course page

nodes.label: grade_grade::is_hidden() - grade visibility gate
nodes.rationale: Covers both hide levels: a grade hidden for that learner in the Grader report and the item's Hidden / Hidden until; any grade shown inside the activity must go through it.

nodes.label: Reading a grade: grade_item::fetch() then get_grade($userid, false)
nodes.norm_label: reading a grade: grade_item::fetch() then get_grade($userid, false)
nodes.rationale: false so that merely looking does not insert an empty grade row; grade_get_grades() is avoided because its docblock warns it can trigger a full course regrade.

nodes.label: What a learner sees: own grade shown only while grade_grade::is_hidden() is false
nodes.norm_label: what a learner sees: own grade shown only while grade_grade::is_hidden() is false
nodes.rationale: Cheap read-only path; no gate on the course showgrades setting because no core activity consults it before displaying a grade inside the activity.

nodes.label: lib.php: thin bridge of module callbacks (instances, grades, calendar, reset, pluginfile)
nodes.norm_label: lib.php: thin bridge of module callbacks (instances, grades, calendar, reset, pluginfile)
nodes.rationale: Callbacks are plain functions core looks up by name (function_exists); a misspelled callback is never called and nothing complains, so names must be exact.

nodes.norm_label: tests this design needs (xss cleaning, server-side deadline, race, transaction guard, hidden grades, file access, capability split, teacher erasure, rescale, locked grades, backup round-trip, privacy, calendar, completion)

nodes.label: UNIQUE KEY (reflectjournalid, userid): enforces one entry per learner
nodes.norm_label: unique key (reflectjournalid, userid): enforces one entry per learner

nodes.label: Rulings 2026-11-24: course reset is a must-have; no entry deletion; grades visible in activity per gradebook rules
nodes.norm_label: rulings 2026-11-24: course reset is a must-have; no entry deletion; grades visible in activity per gradebook rules

nodes.label: Feedback is not mirrored into the gradebook
nodes.norm_label: feedback is not mirrored into the gradebook
nodes.rationale: Feedback is visible the moment it is saved (PRD L3) while grades follow the gradebook hidden setting; one store cannot serve both rules and two copies would drift, so the gradebook Feedback column stays empty for this activity.

nodes.label: core\persistent evaluated and not adopted for the entry row
nodes.norm_label: core\persistent evaluated and not adopted for the entry row
nodes.rationale: create() always writes a usermodified column this table does not have; only 3 of 38 extenders in 5.3 are activity modules; revisit if a second table appears.

nodes.label: Duplicate-key race recovery: catch dml_write_exception, re-read, update
nodes.norm_label: duplicate-key race recovery: catch dml_write_exception, re-read, update
nodes.rationale: Two saves racing for one learner can both pass the exists-check; the unique index is the enforcement. The race test is deterministic: entry::find_existing() is the single existence probe and the test swaps a subclass that inserts the competing row on its first call.

nodes.label: Grade visibility owned by the gradebook (no FEATURE_CONTROLS_GRADE_VISIBILITY, no hidden in itemdetails)
nodes.norm_label: grade visibility owned by the gradebook (no feature_controls_grade_visibility, no hidden in itemdetails)
nodes.rationale: The plugin keeps no flag and has no release mechanism; two core settings apply (item hidden/hidden-until and per-learner hide in the Grader report); feedback is not a grade and is never hidden this way.

nodes.label: Keys are documentation; nothing cascades (no FK constraints in Moodle)
nodes.norm_label: keys are documentation; nothing cascades (no fk constraints in moodle)
nodes.rationale: Every driver leaves sql_generator::$foreign_keys false, so a foreign key becomes a plain index; child rows are deleted explicitly in delete_instance, the privacy provider and reset_userdata. UNIQUE KEY is still enforced as a unique index.

nodes.label: Save path never runs inside a delegated transaction
nodes.norm_label: save path never runs inside a delegated transaction
nodes.rationale: On PostgreSQL a failed INSERT puts the whole transaction into an aborted state, so the re-read would fail too; entry::save() starts with $DB->transactions_forbidden() which throws dml_transaction_exception.

nodes.label: Known limitation: no delete-entry action for anyone
nodes.norm_label: known limitation: no delete-entry action for anyone
nodes.rationale: This is what keeps completion once earned, stays true.

nodes.label: pluginfile access chain: module context, require_login, view capability, owner-or-givefeedback, send_stored_file()
nodes.norm_label: pluginfile access chain: module context, require_login, view capability, owner-or-givefeedback, send_stored_file()
nodes.rationale: The split exists because send_stored_file() ends the request, so the access decision has to be callable without it to be testable; pattern follows assignsubmission_file_pluginfile().

nodes.label: Decision: grade visibility follows the gradebook's hidden-grade setting; no custom release mechanism
nodes.norm_label: decision: grade visibility follows the gradebook's hidden-grade setting; no custom release mechanism
nodes.rationale: Learners see their own grade inside the activity whenever the gradebook shows it; the course showgrades switch and the gradebook hidden rules are the only gates.

nodes.label: Future: external web service via namespaced core_external API (db/services.php + classes/external/)
nodes.norm_label: future: external web service via namespaced core_external api (db/services.php + classes/external/)
nodes.rationale: Old global external_* names are deprecated in 5.3 (MDL-81225); the web service must not call the save path inside a transaction because of the PostgreSQL aborted state.

nodes.label: Future: Hooks API registrations (db/hooks.php, PSR-14 array notation)
nodes.norm_label: future: hooks api registrations (db/hooks.php, psr-14 array notation)

nodes.label: reflectjournal_supports(): six declared features + deliberately undeclared ones
nodes.norm_label: reflectjournal_supports(): six declared features + deliberately undeclared ones
nodes.rationale: FEATURE_GROUPMEMBERSONLY must never be passed (plugin_supports() throws); group features not declared in v1; FEATURE_COMPLETION_TRACKS_VIEWS and FEATURE_CONTROLS_GRADE_VISIBILITY deliberately omitted.

nodes.norm_label: core pinned for evidence: moodle_503_stable commit 1156a935ba4 (5.3.1+, 24 commits after v5.3.1)

nodes.norm_label: never docker down: db has no volume, its data lives in the container fs (stop keeps it, down destroys it)

nodes.label: grade_update() return codes: OK / ITEM_LOCKED / FAILED / MULTIPLE
nodes.norm_label: grade_update() return codes: ok / item_locked / failed / multiple
nodes.rationale: Return codes are checked on every write; MULTIPLE means a bug and raises a coding exception; ITEM_LOCKED tells the teacher to unlock in the gradebook and nothing is retried.

nodes.label: Backup/restore scope: config always, entries behind user-data setting
nodes.norm_label: backup/restore scope: config always, entries behind user-data setting
nodes.rationale: userid and feedbackby remapped with get_mappingid('user') (missing user maps to 0); deadline shifted via apply_date_offset; files via add_related_files; action events are not copied so restore queues refresh_mod_calendar_events_task.

nodes.label: Events API logging: entry_submitted, entry_updated, feedback_added, course_module_viewed, course_module_instance_list_viewed
nodes.norm_label: events api logging: entry_submitted, entry_updated, feedback_added, course_module_viewed, course_module_instance_list_viewed

nodes.label: feedbackby column: id of the teacher who wrote the feedback
nodes.norm_label: feedbackby column: id of the teacher who wrote the feedback
nodes.rationale: Needed so the learner can see who responded and so tests can check who saved what; declared in privacy metadata alongside userid.

nodes.label: grade_update() - the only grade write path (lib/gradelib.php)
nodes.norm_label: grade_update() - the only grade write path (lib/gradelib.php)
nodes.rationale: A grade is addressed by user id only, so a learner with no entry can be graded; it creates or updates the grade item.

nodes.label: classes/privacy/provider.php: metadata, export, delete, userlist provider
nodes.norm_label: classes/privacy/provider.php: metadata, export, delete, userlist provider
nodes.rationale: Implements the metadata provider, plugin provider and core_userlist_provider (mandatory); grades belong to the gradebook and are covered by its own provider.

nodes.label: reflectjournal_rescale_activity_grades() callback
nodes.rationale: No plugin data involved: loads the grade item and calls rescale_grades_keep_percentage(); must return true or core throws cannotreprocessgrades (a null return fails too).

nodes.label: Dev environment verified: moodle-docker f0583ec, MOODLE_503_STABLE (5.3.1+), plugin bind-mounted at public/mod/reflectjournal
nodes.norm_label: dev environment verified: moodle-docker f0583ec, moodle_503_stable (5.3.1+), plugin bind-mounted at public/mod/reflectjournal

nodes.label: ADR-0007: Gradebook is the only grade store
nodes.norm_label: adr-0007: gradebook is the only grade store

nodes.label: ADR-0008: feedbackby privacy semantics (teacher as data subject)
nodes.norm_label: adr-0008: feedbackby privacy semantics (teacher as data subject)

nodes.label: Rejected alternative: mod_assign-style plugin-owned grade table re-pushed on rescale
nodes.norm_label: rejected alternative: mod_assign-style plugin-owned grade table re-pushed on rescale
nodes.rationale: assign_rescale_activity_grades() rescales its own table and pushes again; rejected here because two stores can disagree and a grade on the entry row cannot grade an entryless learner.

nodes.label: Decision: the gradebook is the single grade store (no plugin-side grade column)
nodes.norm_label: decision: the gradebook is the single grade store (no plugin-side grade column)
nodes.rationale: Two stores can disagree: a Grader-report edit overrides the grade so later raw-grade writes no longer change the final grade; a grade on the entry row cannot hold a learner with no entry; a plugin-owned copy needs its own backup/restore/reset code. reflectjournal_update_grades() looks empty on purpose, with a docblock linking here so nobody fixes it into a second writer.

nodes.label: Decision: feedback written by a teacher is that teacher's personal data
nodes.norm_label: decision: feedback written by a teacher is that teacher's personal data
nodes.rationale: The feedback is the teacher's substantive work record, not a bookkeeping column; mod_assign treats grader as a data subject; anonymise-only was rejected because the learner normally knows who wrote the feedback, so removing the id alone is not erasure.

nodes.label: Teacher erasure: feedback text/format/timestamp and files deleted, feedbackby=0, entry and grade untouched
nodes.norm_label: teacher erasure: feedback text/format/timestamp and files deleted, feedbackby=0, entry and grade untouched
nodes.rationale: Core deletes authored content in the same situation (delete_marks_for_users()); the grade stays because it is the gradebook's data, not the plugin's (ADR-0007). Accepted cost: a learner can lose feedback text and files when a teacher is erased.

nodes.label: Design principle: use Moodle core, never reinvent
nodes.norm_label: design principle: use moodle core, never reinvent
nodes.rationale: Each mechanism names the core API it uses, cited by file and function; anything not on the ledger must justify itself in an ADR before being written custom.

nodes.norm_label: capability mod/reflectjournal:submit (create and edit own entry until deadline)

nodes.label: get_enrolled_sql($context, 'mod/reflectjournal:submit', 0, true) - submissions list base query
nodes.norm_label: get_enrolled_sql($context, 'mod/reflectjournal:submit', 0, true) - submissions list base query
nodes.rationale: The last true is $onlyactive, so suspended, not-yet-started and ended enrolments are left out; no group filtering in v1.

nodes.label: Output: mod_reflectjournal\output\renderer + renderables + Mustache templates
nodes.rationale: No inline HTML in PHP; classes get the renderer through core\output\renderer_helper, not the $PAGE/$OUTPUT globals.

nodes.label: Submissions list: core_table\sql_table over get_enrolled_sql with LEFT JOIN on entries
nodes.norm_label: submissions list: core_table\sql_table over get_enrolled_sql with left join on entries
nodes.rationale: Core paging and sorting; a learner with no entry still gets a row.

nodes.label: Known limitation: suspended learners not in the submissions list (entries stay, completion holds)
nodes.norm_label: known limitation: suspended learners not in the submissions list (entries stay, completion holds)
nodes.rationale: Matches core's participants list; rows are not deleted; a show-suspended filter gated on both moodle/course:enrolreview and moodle/course:viewsuspendedusers is nice-to-have.

nodes.label: Output cleaning: every stored text printed through format_text()
nodes.norm_label: output cleaning: every stored text printed through format_text()
nodes.rationale: 5.3 editors store text uncleaned, so output is where content is purified; never noclean; in Mustache triple-brace only for HTML that format_text() returned; tests save script tags in prompt, entry and feedback.

nodes.norm_label: e1: deadline visible in the calendar and on the course page

nodes.norm_label: t7: activity works with course completion (entry submitted means complete)

nodes.rationale: Single-context approach: root GLOSSARY.md for terms + docs/adr/ for decisions.

nodes.label: Moodle Docker stack
nodes.rationale: Every shell sources docker/env.sh (sets $MOODLE_DOCKER_BIN, wwwroot, port 8000). Start/stop keeps data - never 'down'; never 'down -v' or volume prunes without asking (DB has no volume; other projects share this host). Site at http://localhost:8000.

nodes.label: ADR-0006 (workflow preferences override skill defaults)
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md workflow preferences override the defaults of imported skills; also the reason git worktrees are disabled.

nodes.label: Git worktrees disabled (work in place)
nodes.rationale: The docker stack bind-mounts this exact path, so work in place: one feature branch at a time, never on main; sequential subagent implementers only, never two writers in this tree at once.

nodes.label: feedback
nodes.rationale: Teacher's private response stored on the entry row; distinct from the grade.

nodes.label: gradebook
nodes.rationale: Grades flow via grade_update(), no custom table.

nodes.label: GitHub issue tracker (jeius/moodle-mod_reflectjournal via gh CLI)
nodes.norm_label: github issue tracker (jeius/moodle-mod_reflectjournal via gh cli)
nodes.rationale: All operations via gh; infer repo from git remote; file issues only into the user's own repo and verify with gh repo view before the first gh issue create in a fork; PRs as a triage/request surface set to no.

nodes.label: Native issue dependencies (blocked-by edges)
nodes.rationale: Canonical, UI-visible blocking via gh blocked-by edges (database ids via the dependencies API); fallback 'Blocked by:' body line; a ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed; count open blockers with issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by.

nodes.label: Wayfinding operations (map + child tickets)
nodes.rationale: Used by /wayfinder: a single map issue labelled wayfinder:map holding Notes/Decisions-so-far/Fog, child issues as tickets (wayfinder:<type> labels); frontier query lists open unblocked unassigned children in map order; claim assigns @me; resolve comments, closes, and appends a context pointer to Decisions-so-far; a map's destination is usually a spec, handing off to /to-spec.

nodes.label: Canonical triage roles mapped to tracker labels
nodes.norm_label: canonical triage roles mapped to tracker labels
nodes.rationale: Five canonical triage roles map 1:1 to tracker label strings: needs-triage (maintainer evaluates), needs-info (waiting on reporter), ready-for-agent (fully specified, ready for an AFK agent), ready-for-human (requires human implementation), wontfix (will not be actioned).

nodes.label: Spec/plan publication overrides
nodes.rationale: Canonical spec is a committed file specs/NNN-slug.md; '/to-spec' writes the file then a parent issue that only summarizes and links (no ready-for-agent on the parent — tickets only); '/to-tickets' tickets carry a 'Spec: specs/NNN-slug.md' line and keep native blocked-by edges; these override the skills' publication defaults.

nodes.label: Graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Snapshot of docs + code in graphify-out/ (graph.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.json). Query before grepping for questions spanning documents (query/affected/path/explain); it can lag the working tree so the source file wins; refresh only on user request via /graphify . --update.

nodes.label: L2: learner edits until the deadline, then locked; no deadline means always editable
nodes.norm_label: l2: learner edits until the deadline, then locked; no deadline means always editable

nodes.label: T2: teacher sets an optional deadline; entries lock after it
nodes.norm_label: t2: teacher sets an optional deadline; entries lock after it

nodes.norm_label: decision: optional deadline - none means the journal is always open

nodes.label: Plan lifecycle ready -> in-progress -> done; first commit of PR
nodes.norm_label: plan lifecycle ready -> in-progress -> done; first commit of pr
nodes.rationale: Committed as the first commit of the ticket's PR so the PR reads spec -> plan -> code; never deleted.

nodes.label: Spec lifecycle draft -> approved -> on main -> implemented
nodes.norm_label: spec lifecycle draft -> approved -> on main -> implemented

nodes.label: Business logic in namespaced classes/

PHP 8.3 floor with 8.4 in CI, PostgreSQL 17 (minimum raised from 15), Node 22 LTS, $plugin->requires = 2026100500.

nodes.norm_label: pinned moodle-docker clone outside the repo (f0583ec)

nodes.label: Repo root = plugin root

nodes.norm_label: plugin bind mount via pinned clone's local.yml
nodes.rationale: The plugin repo sits outside the core checkout, so it must appear inside the container at /var/www/html/public/mod/reflectjournal without copying files or editing core. Symlink into moodle/ dangles inside the container (bind mounts can't follow paths outside the mounted tree); copy/sync drifts; nesting the repo inside moodle/public/mod/ inverts the plugin-at-root layout (ADR-0003) — all rejected.

Repo note: no specific file paths or code snippets (they go stale), with one exception - a prototype snippet that encodes a decision more precisely than prose may be inlined, trimmed to the decision-rich parts.
